# Market Claim Verifier

> Check financial claims against SEC filings with Meta’s open-weight Muse Spark Open. Muse selects tools and drafts explanations; Python performs calculations, validates evidence and determines the final verdict.

## Start here

- [Judge guide](JUDGES.md): 3-minute path, four equally weighted criteria, bonus categories and [Limits](JUDGES.md#limits).
- [Live demo](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/), [website source](docs/site/index.html), [explorer source](docs/explorer/index.html): saved checks, not fresh model execution. [Run live checks locally](README.md#run-it) with keys/network; browser uploads remain planned.
- [Video — TODO (Claude)](JUDGES.md#demo-video-todo), [Live check — TODO (Claude)](JUDGES.md#live-check-todo), [In the wild — TODO (Claude)](JUDGES.md#in-the-wild-todo): publication/findings URLs pending.
- [Verification instructions](AGENTS.md) and [offline entry point](scripts/verify.sh): `python3 scripts/check_links.py` and `UV_OFFLINE=1 sh scripts/verify.sh`; offline dependency setup requires a populated cache. No model calls or SEC fetches.

## Headline claims and proof

- [Original v2 report, held-out metrics](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md#metrics): Baseten Muse Spark Open verifier **240/266 = 90.2%**, **1/139 false support**, **$0.019880 mean cost/claim (≈ $0.02)**. False support accepts a reference contradicted/insufficient claim as supported; failures count as wrong. Cost/latency means follow completed-pair accounting.
- [Same held-out comparison](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md): Muse Spark Open agent on Baseten **240/266 (90.2%)**, Fireworks **237/266 (89.1%)**; hosted Muse Spark 1.3 agent **218/266 (82.0%)**. Mean costs **$0.019880 / $0.019973 / $0.025880** respectively. No-tool baselines **56/266 / 51/266 / 111/266**, in the same order. Model variants differ; these are recorded workflow results, not a hosting-only causal comparison.
- [Apple saved check](docs/evidence/posts-2026-10-28/demo-thread-baseten/report.json), [readable report](docs/evidence/posts-2026-10-28/demo-thread-baseten/report.html): “$416.2B in one quarter” uses full-year revenue; fiscal Q4 2025 was **$102.5B**, making the claim about **4×** the quarter. Quarter derived from annual minus nine-month revenue.
- [Provider adapters](src/claimcheck/providers.py), [manifest](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/manifest.json), [provider diagram](docs/diagrams/providers.mmd): same agent loop and Python checks on both open-weight hosts. Exact IDs: `meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026` (Baseten), `accounts/fireworks/models/muse-spark-open` (Fireworks), `muse-spark-1.3` (Meta Model API). [Media adapter](src/claimcheck/ingest_media.py) uses `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0` for audio and Muse Spark OCR for images/sample frames before the chosen text verifier.
- [Agent and tools](src/claimcheck/agent.py), [tool definitions](src/claimcheck/tools.py), [release tools](src/claimcheck/release_tools.py): Muse chooses fact lookup, period listing, change calculation, history ranking or release lookup/quote selection. [Python checks](src/claimcheck/checks.py), [release checks](src/claimcheck/release_checks.py), [budget ledger](src/claimcheck/budget.py): arithmetic, periods, precision, citations, quote integrity, final verdict and reserve-before-call accounting. Follow the [real Alphabet trace](docs/evidence/2026-10-27/20261027T222758Z-8959a100.json) and [sequence diagram](docs/diagrams/real-run-sequence.mmd).
- [Original real-world News probe](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-02/REPORT.md): 80 paraphrased published-feed items on the pre-fix agent and post CLI across three providers. Four independent primary truth labels, 53 scope-only abstention expectations and 23 US items requiring review; do not call mixed agreement broad real-world accuracy.
- [POST-HOC FIX RECHECK](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-03-fixcheck/REPORT.md): unchanged, previously seen News inputs after fixes, with separate first/adaptive attempts and publication-date context. All attempts and later Threads share a $5/provider cap; not held out, no new gold or OCR/ASR retest.
- [Prompts](prompts/), [replay tests](tests/test_live_replay.py), [figure registry](docs/figures/figures.json): auditable requests, replayed outputs and figure sources.
- [Build log](BUILD_LOG.md), [dated changelog](CHANGELOG.md), [demo opening disclosure](demo/JUDGE_INTRO.md): nothing in the repository pre-existed the hackathon; first commit **2026-10-27, 7c5670b**. SEC data and dependencies are credited below.

## Limits and retained records

- [Original evaluation](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md): **357 total claims = 91 dev + 266 held out**, generated cases and paraphrased source sentences. Full-set results are not held-out results or real-world multimedia accuracy. [Frozen claims](eval/v2/claims-v2.jsonl), [corrected claims](eval/v2/claims-v2-corrected.jsonl), [registered-gold report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT-registered-gold.md): two corrections; [manifest](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/manifest.json) records a dirty working tree. [Historical full-set results and failure review](JUDGES.md#historical-results-and-failure-review) include stopped/resumed attempts.
- [Post-hoc report](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-28-r2-posthoc/REPORT.md): agents only, same **357** claims; Fireworks **329/357**, Baseten **325/357**, Meta **305/357**. Fixes followed failure inspection; this is not a new held-out result. Empty single-shot summary rows are not results; zero observed false support is not a general error rate.
- [Input/source boundaries](JUDGES.md#input-and-source-boundaries), [data policy](docs/DATA_SOURCES.md), [quality findings](docs/DATA_QUALITY.md): US equities; SEC XBRL tiers L1–L3 plus eligible L4 releases. Tagging/restatement, fiscal-period and source limits apply. Event context is conditional metadata, not authenticated evidence; reports review statements rather than issue investment ratings.
- [Media studies and all disclosures](JUDGES.md#media-studies): original synthetic probes, retained failed attempts, frozen-ASR rechecks, paired format study and real Microsoft/Tesla follow-ups. Coverage is distinct from accuracy; text rechecks do not retest OCR/ASR. One real AV scene and repeated/synthetic facts do not establish broad financial-media accuracy. Speaker identity, word alignment, chart geometry and cross-modal coverage remain incomplete.
- [Cost accounting](JUDGES.md#cost-accounting), [provider rates](docs/PROVIDERS.md): dated rates and observed ledger estimates, not invoices or service guarantees; media/extraction add costs. The local queue is not a discounted Batch API.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): L4 earnings releases are implemented; browser uploads, verified full-call speaker attribution, market-multiple claims and Taiwan filings remain planned. [Most Viral case](JUDGES.md#bonus-categories) describes sharing potential, not measured reach/adoption.
- [MIT license](LICENSE), [SEC/data/media credits](CREDITS.md), [media process](docs/PROCESS-media.md), [test records](docs/TEST_RECORDS.md): distinguish verifier model calls from offline image/voice/music production; preserve failed/partial evidence and avoid paid reruns for offline verification.
